outcome: Maternal injuries (infection, pain, burn injuries, retained surgical bodies, fetal/neonatal death)
Neonatal injuries (severe/mild asphyxia, burn injuries, fetal/neonatal death)
cohort: The study participants are mothers and neonates represented in obstetric claims reported to the Patient Insurance Center in Finland between 2012 and 2022.
finding: The study identified 849 obstetric claims between 2012 and 2022 in Finland, with 26.4% receiving compensation, and found an increasing trend in both claims and compensation rates, primarily due to substandard care.
mod_finding: More claims were filed and compensated for cesarean and vacuum-assisted deliveries compared to unassisted vaginal deliveries.
